body.text: Coins named for Grand Theft Auto VI. Rockstar Games posted on 2025-11-06 that the game will release on Thursday, November 19, 2026, and on 2026-11-12 that it is one week away; traders' recaps of 2026-11-14 and 2026-11-15 say GTA coins are trending. Seventeen coins are measured, each with GTA in its name or description: WASTED ("the iconic GTA death screen"), GTA6CAT, GTA Dollars, Ah shit, here we go again. ("The most iconic GTA meme of all time, with GTA 6 coming out"), gtacoin (LaunchLab; "the one coin for all of gta"), Macca The Gator ("GTA 6 Mascot"), State of Leonida ("The home state of GTA VI"), Peekhole ("a parody of OnlyFans inside GTA 6"), GTA memes, Jason Duval (named for a GTA VI protagonist; it says holders earn $TTWO stock, which is not verified here), Bawsaq (GTA's fictional stock exchange, "from the world of GTA 6"), Rocco, EEAGLE and Mission Passed (from 2026-11-06), and, from 2026-11-16, GRAND THEFT CRYPTO ("The first GTA server with real cryptocurrency"; its account describes a GTA-style role-play server, not verified here), Doug The Frog ("the frog... from Macca the Gator..., the cartoon inside GTA 6") and Cyber Dacity Coin ("GTA-inspired chaos to neon Miami"). All but gtacoin are on Pump.fun. Dates from Codex: the GTA6CAT and GTA memes pools opened in late August 2026, Macca The Gator, Jason Duval, Peekhole, EEAGLE and WASTED in October, and the other ten between 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-16, all ahead of the release. Coins named only for the in-game Dacity Coin brand are a separate narrative, paused on 2026-11-16. None of the coins is shown to be connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two. Measured: seventeen coins across all their pools.

Most recent observation of the story (Nov 16, 2026): Posts of 2026-11-15 and 2026-11-16 count down to the 2026-11-19 release and list GTA coins to track (e1:0); a recap of 2026-11-16 says GTA coins are still the meta (e1:3). Claims in posts; nothing here links any coin to Rockstar. Seventeen coins traded $7,687,203 over the chart window to 05:00 UTC, against $13,455,413 for fourteen coins on 2026-11-15. GTA6CAT carries $1,577,141 and WASTED $1,349,962; GTA Dollars fell from $3,204,997 to $195,465. The three coins added today traded $495,606 (GRAND THEFT CRYPTO), $460,715 (Cyber Dacity Coin) and $333,996 (Doug The Frog). Mission Passed ($3,495) and EEAGLE ($2,191) are nearly inactive. No coin is shown to be connected to Rockstar Games.
